PriceReport.title: PriceReport
PriceReport.description: A crowd-sourced platform tracking live market prices of food, fuel, goods, and services across markets in Nigeria.

id.description: Unique identifier of the price report

unit.description: Standard unit reference of pricing (e.g. Crate, Mudu, 50kg bag, Per Litre)

prevPrice.description: Previous price for comparison inside the market

state.description: State where the market is located

verified.description: Whether the price report was verified by an administrator

ownerId.description: UID of the user who submitted the report

dateObserved.description: Specific date when this price was observed (YYYY-MM-DD)

icon.description: Icon or emoji representing the product

upvotes.description: Count of upvotes from community verification

voters.description: Map mapping user UIDs to vote strings ('up' | 'down') to prevent double voting

/reports/{reportId}.description: Collection of all crowd-sourced price reports across Nigeria.
